findings.title: Fallback layout signature omits wrapping score text
findings.detail: Without ResizeObserver, racer-stats text changes during ordinary play at line1432 onward but is absent from the fallback layout key. The .racer-stats paragraph may wrap inside its auto grid row, shrinking the height-constrained arena while visibility, touch pads, text preferences and absent/unchanged encounter copy remain identical. refreshBoardLayout then skips measurement and the painter receives the prior fitted width. CSS max-height can contain the bitmap while leaving actor/trail scaling based on stale width. Observer-capable browsers are unaffected.
findings.recommendation: Include both stats strings and other variable wrapping host-owned HUD copy in the fallback layout signature, or otherwise observe those reflows. Add one bounded actual-host no-RO test driven by a normal score/capture text transition, and retain unchanged-frame no-measure coverage.
findings.evidenceBasis: Static source/CSS analysis; not a native reproduction.
